answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 72 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a quill bet on surviving 72 epochs of grading, and every ledge settlement recomputes the jetty schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 6 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 6 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
